## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new section, page, content type or tooling
- [ ] `fix`: bug, broken behaviour or wrong copy
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore`: dependencies, configuration, CI or release
- [ ] Other: <!-- refactor, perf, style, test, build, revert -->
- [ ] Breaking: changes existing URLs or restructures the site

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is named `feature/`, `fix/`, `chore/` or `docs/`, and the title is a Conventional Commit.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run dashes` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Browser checks relevant to the change pass (`verify`, `smoke`, `navspy`, `navclick`, `form`, `perf`), or none apply.
- [ ] Copy follows the house style: no dash-like characters other than `-`, British English, plain prose, nothing invented.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for any user-visible change.
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for any visual change, in both themes where it matters.
